aiPipelineSettings.title: AI Pipeline Settings
aiPipelineSettings.description: Shows .env values as defaults. Saving here applies without redeploy (secrets cannot be changed here).
aiPipelineSettings.presetsHint: Choose Method 1 (Realtime S2S), Method 2 (ASR→MT→TTS + glossary quality pack), or Method 3 (fully local).
aiPipelineSettings.customPreset: Current slots/quality flags differ from the named presets (custom).
aiPipelineSettings.s2sSlotIgnored: With Mode 1 (Realtime S2S), ASR/MT/TTS slots are ignored and speech-to-speech is kept.
aiPipelineSettings.qualityPackHint: Mode 2 enables glossary, language-group parallelism, subtitle cache/TM, partial subtitles, and LLM correction.
aiPipelineSettings.localHint: Method 3 recognizes and translates with Gemma 4 E2B and synthesizes translated audio with Qwen3-TTS, all on the local GPU with no external traffic. Vietnamese targets get subtitles only. Glossary and LLM correction are not supported.
aiPipelineSettings.advancedLocalHint: Advanced: asr/mt=local uses the same local Gemma as Method 3; tts=local uses Qwen3-TTS (ja/en/zh; Vietnamese is subtitles only).

realtime_s2s.label: Mode 1: Realtime speech API
realtime_s2s.desc: OpenAI Realtime S2S for low-latency translated audio.

quality_cascade.label: Mode 2: Quality cascade (glossary)
quality_cascade.desc: ASR→MT→TTS with best cloud LLM, glossary, parallel, subtitle optimization.

local_gemma.label: Method 3: Fully local
local_gemma.desc: ASR/MT with Gemma 4 E2B, audio with Qwen3-TTS. No external traffic (vi: subtitles only).

pipelineWarning.localSlotAdvanced: Local slots are an advanced implementation option (not a mode in themselves). They do not switch to the cloud even when the runtime/model is not installed: ASR/MT become unavailable and TTS falls back to subtitles only.

pipelineWarning.geminiLiveFallback: gemini_live falls back to gpt4o_transcribe because GEMINI_API_KEY or its library is not available.
